content: {"paper_id":"lab-9dab3341b9f1","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"image-segmentation","exact_quote":"Superpixel segmentation aims at dividing the input image into some representative regions containing pixels with similar and consistent intrinsic properties","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要首句明确研究超像素分割，即将图像划分为代表性区域，属于图像分割任务。"},{"keyword_id":"subspace-clustering","exact_quote":"we regard each representative region with independent semantic information as a subspace, and correspondingly formulate superpixel segmentation as a subspace clustering problem to preserve more detailed content boundaries.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确把每个代表性区域视为子空间，并将超像素分割形式化为子空间聚类问题，属于该任务。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"we devise a spatial regularization and propose a novel convex locality-constrained subspace clustering model that is able to constrain the spatial adjacent pixels with similar attributes to be clustered into a superpixel","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"提出空间正则化，利用空间相邻像素属性相似性施加局部几何一致性约束，符合图与流形正则化定义。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
